claim_boundary: This analysis attributes the frozen seed-2101 v2.3 outcome. It does not change or rescue the registered v2.3 decision, select a new gain, establish population replication, redefine stable omission, or authorize a new trainable mechanism.

decision.outcome_interpretation: If exact_rescue_with_sampled_insensitivity passes without either mechanistic limitation above, do not change the model; revise only a future replication estimand prospectively while preserving the failed v2.3 endpoint.

registered_rules.address_interference_material: The retained mean absolute cross contribution is at least one third of the retained mean absolute self contribution.
registered_rules.exact_rescue_with_sampled_insensitivity: The paired lower bound for retained dual-minus-v1 exact probability exceeds zero while the frozen sampled learned-accuracy contrast interval contains zero.
registered_rules.omission_dominant: The participant-bootstrap lower bound for omitted error-mass fraction exceeds 0.50.
registered_rules.retained_local_sufficient: For P-off/L-intact, retained exact-probability lower bound exceeds 0.65, omitted upper bound is at most 0.55, and retained-minus-omitted paired lower bound exceeds 0.10.
registered_rules.retained_value_conversion_limited: Retained local sufficiency fails while retained self contribution has a positive bootstrap lower bound and retained cells account for at least half of v1 exact error mass.
registered_rules.slope_source: Name the group with the largest positive v1 exact-probability slope contribution and report every signed contribution; this is descriptive and does not redefine the v2.3 behavioral endpoint.

lock.immutability: The attribution may now execute only on the frozen seed-2101 backbone, v2.3 gain, Liu schedule, exact-probability temperature, bootstrap seed, and registered estimands. Any source repair requires a superseding lock without changing scientific rules.
